page.overview:
Who is Spider Spirits?

The are a group of seven beautiful demonesses that dwelled in Coiled Silk Cave

The Spider Spirits were all beautiful woman with willow brows, cherry red lips, kingfisher plume hairpins, and crimson skirts.

The Spider Spirits all studied Daoism together with the Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord and mastered magical abilities.

When Tang Sanzang came to the Spider Spirits's estate looking for food, they tried to feed him disguised human flesh, but he refused. Angered at his refusal, the Spider Spirits tied him up and spun a cocoon around him.
